comparisons.name: Dynamic Patch vs Static
comparisons.secondary: paired bootstrap CI for C and L differences

sample_size.note: Z-effect provides a REFERENCE RANGE only; DAG Patch effect may be larger (structural benefit), similar (split+reroute equivalent), or smaller/negative (adaptation cost + detection latency). This range CANNOT guarantee statistical power for any specific effect size. Power calculation requires pilot data from the P1-B smoke run (discordant pair rate unknown until then).
sample_size.mcnemar_discordant_needed: b+c ≥ 10 discordant pairs for meaningful McNemar
sample_size.recommended_n_tasks: TBD: requires P1-B smoke discordant-pair rate before any sample-size recommendation can be made. The Z-effect range is a reference only.
sample_size.stopping_rule: fixed-n (no interim analysis); if <10 discordant pairs, report as underpowered

quality_definition: task-level binary: final output within tolerance of gold
cost_definition: total tokens per task (all nodes + recovery overhead)
latency_definition: Primary: end_to_end_wall (serial execution wall-clock per task, measured by the P1-B executor). Secondary: critical-path estimate for reference only (current P1-B executes serially; parallel critical-path is a design target not yet implemented in the real executor).

fairness.same_tasks: all strategies see identical task sets
fairness.same_initial_dag: same initial topology and model assignment
fairness.budget_policy: per-task budget cap; over-budget = task failure
fairness.metrics_scope: Q counted at task level; C/L per task; per-node detail logged

exclusion_criteria.infrastructure_failure: exclude task if ANY strategy hit infra error (not model failure); report count
exclusion_criteria.timeout: Timeout trajectory: report as task failure (Q=0) for the strategy that timed out; include in analysis with Q=0 (NOT excluded). For latency analysis, report median + IQR (robust to outliers) and note timeout censoring count per strategy. Do NOT silently drop timeout trajectories.
exclusion_criteria.gold_leak: T1b test: trajectory must be identical under perturbed gold

estimated_effect_ranges.null: patch adaptation cost offsets benefit: dQ ≈ 0

timestamp_note: Timestamp = file mtime (1791430121); authoritative time is the git commit hash
